requirements.text: Partition immutable input and count normalized URLs without dropping or duplicating records.
Shuffle keyed blocks across three reducers with bounded spill.
Recover lost compute or shuffle blocks through versioned lineage and committed attempts.

problem.scope: Count a separate immutable URL dataset through three map partitions and three reduce partitions. Shuffle blocks have separate storage ownership; losing a CPU does not imply losing those stored blocks. Counts require deterministic parsing and exactly one selected successful attempt per logical partition. The hash-partitioner box denotes per-map logical partitioning/transport, not a centralized service: underlying map-to-reducer all-to-all block transfers and their network cost remain. Spill boxes likewise summarize per-partition bounded operations.

evidence.testName: L022 only the selected map attempt contributes to URL counts

acceptanceCases.given: The driver holds an original and a retried attempt for logical map 1, both stored with identical rows, plus a fenced partial attempt.
acceptanceCases.then: Totals equal the serial count; only the selected attempt contributes, and reduction refuses to run while any logical map lacks a selection.
acceptanceCases.when: Reduce the three hash partitions with the driver's selected attempt per logical map.

acceptanceCases.given: A logical map is retried after its output block was already stored.
acceptanceCases.then: Count each input record once by selected logical partition, never sum both attempts.
acceptanceCases.when: Choose one successful attempt and reduce.

evidence.testName: L022 driver recovery recomputes only maps whose shuffle blocks were lost

acceptanceCases.given: A map CPU dies while its external shuffle blocks remain intact.
acceptanceCases.then: CPU replacement reuses valid blocks; storage loss recomputes only upstream maps for missing blocks.
acceptanceCases.when: Recover and then separately delete one shuffle store.

acceptanceCases.given: A skewed URL partition exceeds the memory budget.
acceptanceCases.then: The integer URL totals equal a serial reference while in-memory buffering remains bounded.
acceptanceCases.when: Spill sorted partial-count runs and merge.

acceptanceCases.given: Job J is accepted for inputHash H with normalizer version 2.
acceptanceCases.then: The changed resubmissions are rejected with 409 and create no second plan; the unchanged one returns the original acceptance.
acceptanceCases.when: Resubmit J with inputHash H2 or normalizer version 3, then resubmit it unchanged.
